rules.description: One serialized identity cannot ambiguously represent different Actors.
rules.defaultPolicy: Do not infer which Actor was intended.
rules.normalizationPolicy: Check all identity evidence before materialization.
rules.autoRepairPolicy: No automatic repair.
rules.validationPolicy: Block ambiguous identity collisions.
rules.chatInstruction: Choose one canonical Actor identity explicitly.
rules.studioMessage: Actor identity collides with another canonical Actor.

rules.description: Actor visuals must resolve to the canonical Actor-primary identity.
rules.defaultPolicy: Animation frames and portraits are not identity defaults.
rules.normalizationPolicy: Resolve against current Catalog capability and identity evidence.
rules.autoRepairPolicy: No automatic identity substitution.
rules.validationPolicy: Block unproven or conflicting Actor identity.
rules.chatInstruction: Use the Actor-primary canonical identity from CURRENT.
rules.studioMessage: Actor identity is not proven by this serialized value.

rules.description: Simple V1 direct Sprite animation selection resolves from an exact published actions[].animationHandle and does not require Actor ownership or membership in an animation character/entity cluster.
rules.defaultPolicy: An underspecified semantic request may omit animation; an explicit animationHandle never degrades to a guessed or static replacement.
rules.normalizationPolicy: For Simple V1, resolve exact direct animation material from CURRENT directAnimationMaterials/ANIMATION_RETRIEVAL_INDEX. Reviewed character/entity-cluster compatibility remains a backend/native AnimationClip concern only.
rules.autoRepairPolicy: Never replace an explicit unsupported animationHandle with a guessed capability or inferred Actor-owned clip.
rules.validationPolicy: Block only when the exact authored direct animationHandle is unavailable or illegal for the Simple V1 direct-material route; backend/native clip paths retain their own compatibility validation.
rules.chatInstruction: Use one exact published direct animationHandle for Simple V1 Sprite animation; never author raw Animation asset IDs.
rules.studioMessage: Direct animation material is unavailable or invalid for Simple V1.

rules.description: Automatic Chat candidates are exact, materializable CURRENT assets with explicit Cutscene use; review-only fallback records are not suggested automatically.
rules.defaultPolicy: Manual/pinned assets remain user-owned, but automatic suggestions exclude unsafe, ambiguous and needsHumanReview records.
rules.normalizationPolicy: Project automatic Actor candidates to preferred canonical identity and include compatible same-identity dialogue portraits when available.
rules.autoRepairPolicy: Do not auto-suggest generic fallback Layer records such as unclassified sprites merely because Preview can display them.
rules.validationPolicy: Explicit user-selected assets remain subject to normal destination validation.
rules.chatInstruction: Prefer suggestedCandidates for exact assets. Treat assets absent from the safe shortlist as deliberate choices that need stronger Catalog evidence.
rules.studioMessage: Automatic Chat candidate shortlist contains only exact CURRENT authoring-safe assets.

rules.description: Locked dialogue requires a deterministic stage background.
rules.defaultPolicy: The existing Dialogue Stage supplies the canonical background when omitted.
rules.normalizationPolicy: Do not substitute a Catalog visual.
rules.autoRepairPolicy: No repair beyond the Dialogue Stage default.
rules.validationPolicy: Warn when omitted; continue only when the Dialogue Stage default resolves deterministically.
rules.chatInstruction: Use the canonical Dialogue Stage background default.
rules.studioMessage: Dialogue Stage background default is required.

rules.description: Locked dialogue requires a deterministic dialogue frame.
rules.defaultPolicy: The existing Dialogue Stage supplies the canonical frame when omitted.
rules.normalizationPolicy: Do not substitute a UI or portrait asset.
rules.autoRepairPolicy: No repair beyond the Dialogue Stage default.
rules.validationPolicy: Warn when omitted; continue only when the Dialogue Stage default resolves deterministically.
rules.chatInstruction: Use the canonical Dialogue Stage frame default.
rules.studioMessage: Dialogue Stage frame is required.

rules.description: A multi-use Catalog asset is not ambiguous when the serialized destination already selects one legal use.
rules.defaultPolicy: A Layer field selects Layer use, an Effect field selects Effect use, and equivalent typed destinations select their own legal capability.
rules.normalizationPolicy: Validate the exact serialized asset against the destination; suppress generic multiple-use review noise when that destination is legal.
rules.autoRepairPolicy: No asset substitution is performed.
rules.validationPolicy: Block only when the exact asset is illegal for the serialized destination.
rules.chatInstruction: Treat the JSON field destination as part of asset intent. Do not avoid a legal asset merely because Catalog also exposes another use.
rules.studioMessage: Typed destination resolved the Catalog multi-use ambiguity.

rules.description: Dialogue-only portraits cannot overlap an active world presentation without legal isolation.
rules.defaultPolicy: Do not infer Both from simultaneous references.
rules.normalizationPolicy: Validate presentation and temporal isolation before materialization.
rules.autoRepairPolicy: No silent presentation fallback.
rules.validationPolicy: Block illegal world/portrait overlap.
rules.chatInstruction: Use dialogue-only presentation for FACE_TO_FACE_PORTRAITS.
rules.studioMessage: Dialogue actor presentation conflicts with world staging.

rules.description: Dialogue presentation requires a deterministic background.
rules.defaultPolicy: The Dialogue Stage may supply its canonical background when omitted.
rules.normalizationPolicy: Do not invent a background asset.
rules.autoRepairPolicy: No authoring fallback is allowed beyond the Dialogue Stage default.
rules.validationPolicy: Warn when omitted; continue only when the Dialogue Stage default resolves deterministically.
rules.chatInstruction: You may omit this field when using the canonical Dialogue Stage default.
rules.studioMessage: Dialogue Stage default will supply the omitted presentation value.

rules.description: Dialogue font selection is project-owned when no explicit font is authored.
rules.defaultPolicy: Omitted fontAssetId uses the configured project TMP/RTL fallback.
rules.normalizationPolicy: Apply the shared project font fallback during materialization without emitting one validation issue per line.
rules.autoRepairPolicy: No JSON repair is required for an omitted fontAssetId.
rules.validationPolicy: Block only an explicit invalid font requirement or an actual materialization failure, not omission itself.
rules.chatInstruction: Omit fontAssetId unless the scene deliberately requires a specific compatible font; project fallback is the normal default, including RTL text.
rules.studioMessage: Project dialogue font fallback applied.

rules.description: Optional reaction tail padding may not turn a valid final dialogue line into a blocker.
rules.defaultPolicy: Reaction timing belongs to the owning shot/sequence and its optional tail defaults to the remaining owner time.
rules.normalizationPolicy: Clamp negative/overflowing reaction offsets and holdAfterLine to the owning interval after dialogue duration is normalized.
rules.autoRepairPolicy: Clamp mechanically and record the correction without changing the spoken line or Actor identity.
rules.validationPolicy: Explicit missing Actor identity or invalid owner timing remains a blocker.
rules.chatInstruction: Do not hand-tune reaction tails to fit the last frame; Unity clamps optional reaction padding to the owning interval.
rules.studioMessage: Reaction tail timing was fitted to its owner.

rules.description: Emotional Dialogue presentation is owned by the curated CharacterPack repertoire.
rules.defaultPolicy: Use only the exact published defaultExpression or an explicitly supported expression from the participant's authoring-ready CharacterPack; never derive or substitute a portrait.
rules.normalizationPolicy: Apply the closed-world repertoire gate before dialogue materialization.
rules.autoRepairPolicy: Never borrow a portrait, promote a Catalog Actor, require a WorldActor, or fall back to Neutral for unsupported explicit intent.
rules.validationPolicy: Block when the exact curated CharacterPack identity or requested expression cannot resolve.
rules.chatInstruction: Author the dialogue participant by exact local cast[].id; its cast[].identityHandle must resolve to the exact Emotional Dialogue CharacterPack identity. Omit expressionIntent only when that CharacterPack default is intended.
rules.studioMessage: Dialogue presentation was resolved from the exact curated CharacterPack.

rules.description: Fixed-layout Dialogue Stage mechanics are system-owned, while identity and expression remain closed-world CharacterPack data.
rules.defaultPolicy: Speaker/listener stage mechanics may default from the selected preset, but participant identity and presentation must resolve from EMOTIONAL_DIALOGUE_CURRENT.
rules.normalizationPolicy: Apply deterministic stage defaults only after the repertoire and exact expression have passed validation.
rules.autoRepairPolicy: Never use stage defaults to promote an Actor, acquire a portrait, or repair an unsupported expression.
rules.validationPolicy: Block when no exact curated CharacterPack presentation route exists.
rules.chatInstruction: Author speaker/listener as exact local cast[].id aliases. Unity resolves each alias through cast[].identityHandle, which must match an authoring-ready CharacterPack identity; keep expressionIntent exact when explicitly used and omit only mechanical stage values owned by Unity.
rules.studioMessage: Dialogue Stage mechanics defaulted after closed-world identity validation.

rules.description: Each dialogue participant has one primary visual source per presentation context.
rules.defaultPolicy: Portrait and body are not silently merged.
rules.normalizationPolicy: Validate visual source relationships after resolution.
rules.autoRepairPolicy: No automatic source substitution.
rules.validationPolicy: Block portrait/body source conflicts.
rules.chatInstruction: Choose one visual source for each participant context.
rules.studioMessage: Dialogue participant has conflicting visual sources.

rules.description: SUBTITLE_ONLY cannot acquire an unsupported portrait through fallback.
rules.defaultPolicy: Unsupported optional presentation is not repaired into another mode.
rules.normalizationPolicy: Validate preset capability against CURRENT.
rules.autoRepairPolicy: No silent portrait fallback.
rules.validationPolicy: Block explicit unsupported portrait requests.
rules.chatInstruction: Use an explicit portrait-capable preset or keep subtitles only.
rules.studioMessage: Dialogue visual source is unsupported by the preset.

rules.description: Visible Effect obligations may occupy an optional sub-interval of their containing beat.
rules.defaultPolicy: Omitted startOffsetSeconds begins at beat start; omitted durationSeconds ends at beat end. Explicit duration is clamped to the beat end.
rules.normalizationPolicy: Resolve the interval once at the Simple -> existing V3/V5 execution-plan boundary, then pass that exact interval to the existing Effect materializer.
rules.autoRepairPolicy: Do not apply these fields to Actors, Layers, Audio or other visible routes; do not deduplicate repeated Effect handles.
rules.validationPolicy: Block negative/non-finite offsets, non-positive/non-finite durations and starts at or after beat end. Overlap is legal.
rules.chatInstruction: Use startOffsetSeconds and durationSeconds only for visible Effect entries when a beat-local sub-interval is required.
rules.studioMessage: Effect sub-beat timing was resolved into the containing beat interval.

rules.description: Generated Cutscene output must not become authoritative Catalog input.
rules.defaultPolicy: Generated-root paths are excluded from Catalog source scans.
rules.normalizationPolicy: Validate the scan candidate boundary.
rules.autoRepairPolicy: No repair after contamination; fail the consistency gate.
rules.validationPolicy: Block generated-root contamination.
rules.chatInstruction: Generated Cutscene output is runtime output, not authoring source.
rules.studioMessage: Authoritative Catalog scan includes generated Cutscene output.

rules.description: Generated entities belong to an explicit shot, sequence, location, or persistent owner.
rules.defaultPolicy: Default lifetime is the owning shot or sequence.
rules.normalizationPolicy: Apply ownership before materialization and cleanup planning.
rules.autoRepairPolicy: No automatic persistence beyond the owner.
rules.validationPolicy: Block invalid location/lifetime leakage.
rules.chatInstruction: Declare persistence explicitly when an entity must outlive its owner.
rules.studioMessage: Generated entity ownership is invalid or leaks across owners.

rules.description: Mechanical IDs use deterministic owner namespacing.
rules.defaultPolicy: Generated IDs are deterministic from sequence/shot/entity context.
rules.normalizationPolicy: Normalize IDs before semantic validation.
rules.autoRepairPolicy: Repair only when all references are unambiguous.
rules.validationPolicy: Block ambiguous duplicate references.
rules.chatInstruction: Let Unity generate mechanical IDs; do not invent identity IDs.
rules.studioMessage: Mechanical duplicate ID was deterministically repaired.

rules.description: Both requires explicit intent and legal temporal isolation.
rules.defaultPolicy: Legacy fields migrate only when the result is unambiguous.
rules.normalizationPolicy: Infer only a single deterministic presentation mode.
rules.autoRepairPolicy: Do not infer Both.
rules.validationPolicy: Block ambiguous presentation mode.
rules.chatInstruction: Specify WorldActor, DialoguePortrait, or explicitly isolated Both.
rules.studioMessage: Presentation mode is ambiguous.

rules.description: Built-in procedural effects own their visual implementation and do not require an assetId.
rules.defaultPolicy: For an assetless procedural effect type, assetId is omitted.
rules.normalizationPolicy: Remove redundant assetId before validation when the effect type explicitly supports the assetless route.
rules.autoRepairPolicy: Remove the redundant field without a yellow warning.
rules.validationPolicy: Block only illegal effect types or illegal explicit asset-backed routes.
rules.chatInstruction: For built-in procedural effects such as ScreenFlash, omit assetId unless the CURRENT contract explicitly requires an asset-backed effect.
rules.studioMessage: Procedural effect serialized in canonical assetless form.

rules.description: Optional authoring collections are deterministic empty collections.
rules.defaultPolicy: Missing optional collections default to [] where the Contract permits.
rules.normalizationPolicy: Apply before DTO deserialization and before semantic validation.
rules.autoRepairPolicy: Add [] and record the correction.
rules.validationPolicy: Reject null only where the Contract requires a value.
rules.chatInstruction: Emit empty collections for optional fields.
rules.studioMessage: Optional fields default to empty collections.

rules.description: Extra fields outside the canonical V5 DTO are non-authoritative metadata and are removed at the import boundary.
rules.defaultPolicy: Unknown fields do not become part of the package contract merely because ChatGPT emitted them.
rules.normalizationPolicy: Prune unknown V5 properties before canonical field validation, then let required-field validation catch any real omission.
rules.autoRepairPolicy: Remove only fields that have no matching canonical public DTO field; never invent replacement story, identity or asset values.
rules.validationPolicy: Duplicate JSON properties, wrong types, missing required fields and invalid canonical values remain blockers.
rules.chatInstruction: Use only canonical V5 fields. Extra notes belong in supported extension valueJson, not ad-hoc properties.
rules.studioMessage: Unsupported non-canonical V5 field was removed by the import boundary.

rules.description: Locked portrait, monitor, and radio dialogue must use Hold or cut-based Snap camera coverage.
rules.defaultPolicy: camera.movement is hold or cut for locked portrait/monitor/radio dialogue.
rules.normalizationPolicy: Validate at the Simple V1 authoring boundary before semantic lowering and again in V3 semantic validation.
rules.autoRepairPolicy: Do not auto-repair explicit camera movement because that changes authored cinematic intent.
rules.validationPolicy: Block any camera movement other than hold or cut in a locked dialogue beat.
rules.chatInstruction: For locked portrait / monitor / radio dialogue, set camera.movement to hold or cut. Put cinematic camera movement in an adjacent non-dialogue beat.
rules.studioMessage: Locked dialogue permits only Hold or cut-based Snap camera coverage.

rules.description: Authoring fields must contain exact authoring IDs, not source/projection IDs.
rules.defaultPolicy: No default is safe for an explicitly serialized identity leak.
rules.normalizationPolicy: Inspect the serialized token before deserialization/materialization.
rules.autoRepairPolicy: No automatic repair because identity meaning is ambiguous.
rules.validationPolicy: Block sourceRecordId, preview, catalog, and internal projection IDs in authoring fields.
rules.chatInstruction: Use the exact Catalog authoring ID.
rules.studioMessage: Serialized ID is not an authoring ID.

rules.description: A project-owned standardized 6x5 character sheet has one deterministic identity: portrait cells 0..11 and Body_Idle_Front cell 12 belong to the same source identity.
rules.defaultPolicy: Body_Idle_Front is the canonical Actor-primary world identity; Emotional Dialogue identity and portrait presentation remain owned by the curated CharacterPack.
rules.normalizationPolicy: Project this relation from the sheet contract during Catalog analysis and when rehydrating an older CURRENT snapshot.
rules.autoRepairPolicy: Never promote arbitrary vendor sprite-sheet frames or unrelated characters into this identity contract.
rules.validationPolicy: Block only when an explicitly requested identity cannot resolve exactly; otherwise use the deterministic same-source relation.
rules.chatInstruction: For dialogue, author speaker/listener only as exact local cast[].id aliases. Their cast[].identityHandle must resolve to the published CharacterPack identity and supported expression set; do not serialize CharacterPack actorId as the dialogue alias, and a standardized sheet is not a dialogue identity source.
rules.studioMessage: Standardized character sheet identity was projected deterministically.

rules.description: Unity owns baseline scale/proportion and background Cover framing.
rules.defaultPolicy: Authored scale defaults to 1.0; system-managed proportions apply where supported.
rules.normalizationPolicy: Normalize scale and background policy before visual QA.
rules.autoRepairPolicy: Do not repair extreme explicit scale into a creative replacement.
rules.validationPolicy: Report extreme authored scale and visual framing separately.
rules.chatInstruction: Do not compensate for framing with arbitrary scale.
rules.studioMessage: System-managed scale/proportion/background policy applied.

rules.description: A CUTSCENE_SCRIPT_V1 must identify the exact sealed CURRENT contract used to author it.
rules.defaultPolicy: No fingerprint default is permitted because omission cannot prove which contract authored the movie.
rules.normalizationPolicy: Validate schemaHash and authoringRuleRegistryRevision before aliases, schema lowering, asset resolution, or materialization.
rules.autoRepairPolicy: No automatic repair. Regenerate against the matching sealed CURRENT.
rules.validationPolicy: Block missing or stale schemaHash or authoringRuleRegistryRevision with one contract-mismatch diagnostic.
rules.chatInstruction: Copy schemaHash and authoringRuleRegistryRevision exactly from the same sealed CURRENT used for authoring.
rules.studioMessage: V1 CURRENT contract fingerprint is missing or stale.

rules.description: Locked dialogue without actor actions is dialogue-only.
rules.defaultPolicy: lockStaging=true with omitted actorActions defaults to [].
rules.normalizationPolicy: Apply the empty collection before locked-dialogue validation.
rules.autoRepairPolicy: Add [] and record an auto-repair.
rules.validationPolicy: Explicit actor movement/action remains invalid.
rules.chatInstruction: Do not author world movement inside locked dialogue.
rules.studioMessage: Locked dialogue actorActions defaulted to empty.

rules.description: Locked dialogue cannot contain explicit world movement/action.
rules.defaultPolicy: No default or fallback changes explicit creative movement intent.
rules.normalizationPolicy: Validate after defaults and before materialization.
rules.autoRepairPolicy: No automatic repair.
rules.validationPolicy: Block explicit movement/action in locked dialogue.
rules.chatInstruction: Use portrait staging and HOLD/cut camera framing.
rules.studioMessage: Locked dialogue contains explicit movement/action.

rules.description: CURRENT V5 bookkeeping fields with one deterministic value are system-owned defaults.
rules.defaultPolicy: When V5 is proven, omitted contextVersion and empty top-level mechanical collections use the CURRENT deterministic value.
rules.normalizationPolicy: Apply these defaults before canonical DTO validation; project/context binding remains owned by Studio.
rules.autoRepairPolicy: Fill only unambiguous mechanical metadata. Never invent story, identity, duration, assets or creative intent.
rules.validationPolicy: Block contradictory version/identity evidence and genuinely missing creative data.
rules.chatInstruction: Start from the CURRENT canonical package shape, but do not spend creative effort on deterministic bookkeeping fields; Unity may fill them when omitted.
rules.studioMessage: Deterministic V5 envelope metadata was filled by the system.
